description: Get the shipping label for a booked APC consignment and save it to disk. Call any time after book_shipment. APC typically needs 3-5 seconds to generate it, which this tool waits for automatically. APC marks the consignment as printed once the label has been fetched. Returns the local file path. Default save location is ~/Downloads/parcel-toolkit/, overridable via the PARCEL_TOOLKIT_LABELS_DIR env var.

format.description: Label format. PDF for standard printers, ZPL for thermal (Zebra/Rollo), PNG for previews.

waybill.description: The 22-digit WayBill number returned when booking (or from a previously booked consignment).

name: get_label
